title: Rest coordinates characterize block condition
statement: Let $w,s$ be natural numbers, let $i$ be a coordinate in the sign cube of dimension $sw$, and let $x$ be an element of that cube. The condition that every coordinate of the block containing $i$, other than the coordinate corresponding to $i$, has sign $-1$ holds if and only if every coordinate in the block's rest-coordinate set has sign $-1$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a sign vector of dimension $sw$
